human_understanding_delta: Adversarial optimization of the normalized quintic mixed model did not merely approach zero: it exposed an exact algebraic equality chart with phases arg A=2pi/5 and arg B=13pi/10 and amplitude |A|^3=27/320. The leading model vanishes termwise at two antipodal chord directions, but tangent Fourier pairing E3=-conj(E2) gives opposite cubic corrections there. Selecting the negative member resolves this sharp tie lexicographically and replaces an uncontrolled transition with a finite next-mode sign test.
